description: This file implements the NativeJSImplementation class, which provides methods for initializing, deinitializing, creating, running, and terminating JavaScript applications within a native rendering environment. It manages a renderer object and handles asynchronous execution via a thread.

classes.name: NativeJSImplementation
classes.description: A class that manages the lifecycle and operations of native JavaScript applications, including initialization, execution, and termination within a rendering environment.

methods.name: NativeJSImplementation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service, setting the running state.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Starts the renderer thread and initializes the native JS renderer with the specified display.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Stops the renderer and joins the thread, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a new application with specified options and returns its ID.

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Runs an application with the given ID and URL.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code in the context of the specified application.

methods.name: GetApplications
methods.description: Retrieves the list of current applications.

methods.name: TerminateApplication
methods.description: Terminates the application with the specified ID.
